This is a control-mapping exercise over your synthetic inventory. I'll build a control matrix linking each control to QTR assertions, evidence, and test procedures, then run a coverage analysis to pinpoint exceptions and gaps.

```python
import pandas as pd

# --- QTR assertions derived from Rule 2024-07 §3.2 report contents ---
# Report requires: total transaction volume, number of transactions, aggregate value BY CURRENCY
assertions = ["Completeness", "Accuracy", "Valuation/FX", "Cut-off", "Existence/Occurrence", "ITGC/Integrity"]

controls = pd.DataFrame([
    dict(control_id="C1", desc="Daily transaction log reconciliation", freq="Daily",
         evidence="Reconciliation reports; transaction database exports"),
    dict(control_id="C2", desc="Monthly independent review of fee calculations", freq="Monthly",
         evidence="Review sign-offs"),
    dict(control_id="C3", desc="Quarterly data completeness check for QTR", freq="Quarterly",
         evidence="Review sign-offs"),
    dict(control_id="C4", desc="Access control review for reporting system", freq="Not stated",
         evidence="Review sign-offs"),
])

# --- Coverage matrix: control x assertion (Y=covered, P=partial, blank=not covered) ---
cov = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        ["C1", "Y", "P", "",  "P", "Y", ""],
        ["C2", "",  "P", "",  "",  "",  ""],
        ["C3", "Y", "",  "",  "",  "",  ""],
        ["C4", "",  "",  "",  "",  "",  "P"],
    ],
    columns=["control_id"] + assertions,
).set_index("control_id")

print("=== Control Inventory ===")
print(controls.to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== Coverage Matrix (Y=covered, P=partial, blank=not covered) ===")
print(cov.to_string())

# --- Assertion coverage summary ---
summary = []
for a in assertions:
    marks = cov[a]
    n_full = (marks == "Y").sum()
    n_part = (marks == "P").sum()
    summary.append(dict(assertion=a, full_controls=n_full, partial=n_part,
                        status="COVERED" if n_full else ("PARTIAL ONLY" if n_part else "*** NO COVERAGE ***")))
print("\n=== Assertion Coverage Summary ===")
print(pd.DataFrame(summary).to_string(index=False))
```
